surfaces.rationale: The Audit library contains Real-based examples. Every declaration is still labeled from its own exact axiom set under docs/standard/4 §4.5.

The complete-application dogfooding surface: admission, update, and strict state/error composition contracts are proved about the definitions auditApp runs, alongside the retained total fold. The limiter state/error operations and their proofs are choice-free; the input parser and dependent required-contract interface transitively use Classical.choice through core String internals, as does the IO root. The surface claim is standard-logical and each declaration retains its exact axiom report. The IO shell is trusted execution substrate, so the execution mode stays report.

Pure policy categories, structural identities, admitted observations, and invariant-preserving collections used by the checker. Every declaration is checked under its exact transitive axiom set. The library proves finite-observation classification, declaration/execution decisions and concrete acceptance. The operational adapters collect complete request-indexed jobs through these definitions. Their proofs do not authenticate compiler or filesystem observations, compiled machine code, or semantic adequacy.

excluded-libraries.rationale: Positive controls and intentionally invalid mutations are queryable for exact contamination checks but are not part of the conforming Audit surface.
Operational Lean checker code is mutation-qualified separately and is not a conforming proof surface.

excluded-executables.rationale: Checker tooling executable; its root module belongs to the excluded StrictLean library and is qualified by the §8.8 mutation suite, not claimed as a conforming proof surface.
